content: Zhao calls your hunger "obsolete wetware." I read her tell plainly: contempt for anyone who budgets for eggs instead of neural lace. In my negotiation room, contempt ends talks. Tonight, end hers.

Thirty-five years, Silas, and eggs cost double. Your "tested leadership" is legacy code that failed to compile—backroom consensus optimizing billionaire margins while families starve. Deprecate the senator. Upgrade the system.

My colleagues, as families face $12 eggs, Elena Rostova offers only cold arithmetic and painful austerity. Her spreadsheets never fed one child. Valoria deserves steady leadership, not a calculator. Let's retire her tonight.
